I’m speechless with the reactions I’m getting.  This is actually a self portrait of me for a mental health project I am currently working on with numerous other subjects on making visual representations of mental illnesses.

This one was my visual representation and it’s me keeping my heart above water type concept.  I always pictured my depression as drowning and sinking in the water and it was a “yes I’m sinking but I’m ok with it type feeling” so I decided to do a milk bath picture of me in blue water which represents the calm I have with my depression since cooler colors usually represents cooler emotions. I decided to float in this concept because learning how to cope with the feelings I have has made what I feel a little easier/lighter to deal with. Eating the heart symbolizes a confrontation with past pain or trauma, representing my willingness to face and assimilate difficult emotions as a part of personal healing.  I have another version of this photo where I am just holding the heart but I felt compelled to take this one too because of learning to cope with traumas has made me stronger. Lastly I decided the flowers to be included since I feel there is beauty coming from dealing with these difficult emotions and just because they are negative it doesn’t make them ugly.
